name: gh-project-goals
title_zh: 一份 GitHub 项目优化目标说明书
tagline_zh: 读 README 时最怕把作者没说的当成他说的。它只写报告里那段「这个项目在优化什么、为谁优化」，把原话。
tagline_en: Reading a README, you risk mistaking your inference for the author's words. It writes only the optimization.
desc_en: Writes the OPTIMIZATION paragraph of a non-technical GitHub onboarding report: what the project seeks to optimize (time, money, speed, quality, reliability…) and for whom, separating stated goals from interpretation, from facts.goals collected through the GitHub MCP. Used by /onboard-project.
why_zh: 只负责非技术 onboarding 报告里的 OPTIMIZATION 一段，不碰其余章节。
why_en: Owns just the OPTIMIZATION paragraph of a non-technical onboarding report, nothing else. Forces a split between what the source.
limit_zh: 只产出这一段文字，不写完整报告、不做代码分析；依赖 GitHub MCP 抓到的 facts.goals。
limit_en: Outputs only this one paragraph—no full report, no code analysis. Needs facts.goals from the GitHub MCP; if absent it leaves blanks and flags them.
title_en: A GitHub project's optimization goals, facts vs. reading
